g.text: Slow run — the send call fails, the run still lands (correctness never depends on the send)
may have landed; run record STAYS ACTIVE
deactivate the record, tell the user
Recovery loop: the sweeper polls every active run
[each 5 s tick, per active run, budget 15 min]
"Run #N is still not finished after Ns.
It may yet complete -- team status #N."
Eviction stops the sweeper, not the run:
"team status #N" still reads the ledger, and
the run completes for its owner regardless.
The f1r3sky lesson, generalized: the blocking send is an
optimization. Every outcome is reachable from
GET /runs/{run_id} plus a grantee reveal, so a dropped
connection, a restart, or a 504 loses nothing. A resent
same-signed envelope carries the same deploy identity and
re-registers idempotently without a second cap unit.
